properties.summary: Land-use zones traced from the land use plans in Google's North Bayshore Master Plan (April 2023), approved by the Mountain View City Council in June 2023: office, residential, hotel, public use, open space, parking, the district central plant and two flex classes, clipped to the project area line as the plan draws it. The plan calls these general depictions, so every edge is approximate. Ground-floor active uses, streets, the green loop trail, the Shoreline Amphitheatre and the city's separate Gateway plan are left out. Zones, not buildings.
properties.note: Land uses from the approved 2023 master plan, approximate; zones, not buildings.

controls.label: North Shoreline Boulevard / Space Park Way

properties.license: Zones: traced from a public City of Mountain View record (council attachment). Georeference: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps.

properties.label: Office
properties.source: traced: North Bayshore Master Plan (April 2023), Plan 4.1.2, Land use (core master plan area), p. 33
properties.note: Office campus blocks; the plan allows 3,117,931 sq ft of office, including 1,814,681 sq ft rebuilt (Table 4.1.1, p. 34). Office buildings 4 to 8 stories (council report, June 13, 2023, p. 4). Approximate: the plan calls its land use parcels general depictions.

properties.label: Residential
properties.source: traced: North Bayshore Master Plan (April 2023), Plan 4.1.2, Land use (core master plan area), p. 33
properties.note: Up to 7,000 homes across the plan (Table 4.1.1, p. 34), 5 to 15 stories (council report, p. 4). Hatched block edges in the figure mark ground-floor active uses. Approximate: the plan calls its land use parcels general depictions.

properties.label: Hotel
properties.source: traced: North Bayshore Master Plan (April 2023), Plan 4.1.2, Land use (core master plan area), p. 33
properties.note: Up to 525 hotel rooms in two locations, 10 to 13 stories (Table 4.1.1, p. 34; council report, p. 4). Approximate: the plan calls its land use parcels general depictions.

properties.label: Public use
properties.source: traced: North Bayshore Master Plan (April 2023), Plan 4.1.2, Land use (core master plan area), p. 33
properties.note: Public use, as the figure's legend labels it; the figure doesn't name the use. Approximate: the plan calls its land use parcels general depictions.

properties.label: Parking
properties.source: traced: North Bayshore Master Plan (April 2023), Plan 4.1.1, p. 32 (garages outside Plan 4.1.2) and Plan 4.1.2, p. 33
properties.note: Parking garages, including the Shoreline Amphitheatre Lot C garage (SA-P-1), which the plan notes is outside the precise plan area and needs its own development review permit (Plan 4.1.1, p. 32). Approximate: the plan calls its land use parcels general depictions.

properties.label: District central plant
properties.source: traced: North Bayshore Master Plan (April 2023), Plan 4.1.2, Land use (core master plan area), p. 33
properties.note: District central plant for the plan's district utility systems (130,000 sq ft, Table 4.1.1, p. 34). Approximate: the plan calls its land use parcels general depictions.

properties.label: Open space
properties.source: traced: North Bayshore Master Plan (April 2023), Plan 4.1.2, Land use (core master plan area), p. 33
properties.note: Parks and open space; about 26.1 acres in the plan (Table 4.1.1, p. 34). Includes both dedicated public parks and privately owned, publicly accessible open space; the figure doesn't tell them apart. Approximate: the plan calls its land use parcels general depictions.
